journey.title: From knowledge to skill.
journey.lead: Four stages. Each one grows out of the last — from theory to a real profession.

steps.title: Learn
steps.text: Live classes with a mentor. Only as much theory as practice actually needs.

steps.title: Practise
steps.text: Every class is a task. Every week is a mini project. Mistakes are fine — stopping is not.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: You ship a product for a real client or a real problem. That is a portfolio, not a certificate.

steps.title: Grow
steps.text: A job, freelance work or your own project. We stay by your side after graduation too.
